lines: Me
(I hope Rinka-senpai will be alright...)
We had left it to Rinka-senpai to deal with Asuka and Akitsu, and fled to an abandoned area on the outskirts of the city.
Hebiko
Now it isn't just "G," but also that masked woman's underlings are after heberybody huh.
Me
Yeah... Hebiko, from here on we need you to be able to fight. I'll carry Saya.
Hebiko
You're right, take her, please.
I took the still limp and listless Saya from Hebiko.
As I placed her on my back, her warmth and the smell of her blood seeped into it.
Me
(She's still alive... We have to get her treated fast.)
Shikanosuke
Aaaahhhh! This turned into one hell of a situation!! What are we going to do, Fuma!?
Me
So what, Shikanosuke, do you want to turn back and hand this girl over to them?
Shikanosuke
Huh?! How could you say that?!
Shikanosuke
Leaving a wounded girl to die, that's worse than what an Oni would do, Fuma!
Me
Hehe, I thought you might say that. Then let's give our best on the final spurt to Gosha!
Shikanosuke
A-Alright! There's no way we can turn back now!
After a brief rest, we were about to start running again, but at that momentー
Red Oni
Hyuk-hyuk-hyuk, who are you calling worse than an Oni?
Shikanosuke
Aiee!? A-An Oni!?
Blue Oni
We found you♪ If we bring back your headz, Madam will reward uz handsomely!!
Me
Tsk, mercenaries sent by that masked woman? Let's make a run for it!
Once we made it into Gosha's territory, our enemies wouldn't be able to touch us.
This was the start of our desperate escapeー
